body:
As suggested by @Haroenv in #933 I am trying to implement this feature and I have it half working.
Here's my feedback on this:
- it breaks when using `operator: 'and'` in a `refinementList` widget:
> Error: facet_name is not defined in the disjunctiveFacets attribute of the helper configuration
- I based my implementation on the `non-trivial mapping` example and got it working for one refinement at a time. I still cannot seem to get more that one refinement list parameter added to the URL. The previous refinement gets overwritten by the new one on the url. And example on how to implement this is more than welcome for me 😄 

But at least this is starting to allow us to get fully customizable url and title, thanks for the great job so far 👍
